name: somestoken
description: Local task, model and token tracking, opt-in efficiency guidance, and evidence-gated comparisons for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Local token receipts and advice for Codex + Claude Code
interface.longDescription: Reports numerical token usage, calculated provider usage, plan coverage, capability provenance, structural metrics, fixed candidate advice, and Codex limit state through a read-only local contract; the separate recovery companion is explicitly opt-in and never changes ordinary host hooks.
defaultPrompt: Use SomesToken to show the last completed turn.
Use SomesToken to recommend a model and reasoning effort for a bounded task.
